egressAddresses.description: INFRARED_MANAGEMENT_EGRESS: the addresses this cluster reaches the internet from (a Cloud NAT's static address), public and no wider than /24 or /56; a conformance run's new cluster admits them to its API before the nodes' external addresses (workspace TODO 461). Empty: the nodes'.

signIn.description: How people sign in to Infrared.

password.description: The platform admin's email and password sign-in.

enabled.description: INFRARED_SIGN_IN_PASSWORD: false turns password sign-in off once Sign in with Google has worked on the install.

oidc.description: Infrared as the OpenID Connect provider of the install's own tools, Grafana and Gitea (infrared-docs-internal ADR 0053). Off by default; each tool's client exists only while its address is set.

enabled.description: INFRARED_OIDC (api and operator): turn the provider on. Its issuer is the Installation's spec.previews.signInURL with /api/v1/oidc.

grafanaURL.description: INFRARED_OIDC_GRAFANA_URL (api and operator): Grafana's address in a browser, such as https://grafana.example.com, a trailing slash trimmed; its redirect URI is <grafanaURL>/login/generic_oauth. Empty: no Grafana client.

mcpURL.description: INFRARED_OIDC_MCP_URL (api) and, with enabled, INFRARED_MCP_CODE_URL (mcp): the address MCP clients reach the code tools at, signed in through Infrared, the UI's address followed by /mcp/code, such as https://infrared.example.com/mcp/code, a trailing slash trimmed. Empty: no client mcp, and the code tools stay inside the cluster.

installation.description: What the operator writes to the Installation while each field is empty.

previews.description: spec.previews (INFRARED_PREVIEWS, as JSON); empty leaves previews to a person.

signInURL.description: Infrared's public URL, where preview visitors sign in.

ingressHost.description: The name customers point their own domains at with a CNAME.

ingressIP.description: The ingress's public address, for A records on root domains.

managedRoots.description: Domains Infrared manages in Cloudflare, under which any org can claim a subdomain.

cloudflareTokenSecret.description: A Secret in the release namespace whose api-token key may edit DNS for the managed roots.

cloudflareTokenKey.description: The key of cloudflareTokenSecret that holds the token; empty is api-token. infrared-platform-tokens holds it as cloudflare-api-token.

customHostnames.description: On a Gateway edge behind Cloudflare, an address under an org's external Domain becomes a Cloudflare for SaaS custom hostname on the zone of the managed root that holds ingressHost, its origin certificate from Let's Encrypt over HTTP-01.

acmeEmail.description: The address Let's Encrypt writes to about the custom hostnames' origin certificates; empty registers without one.

domainTokenKey.description: The key of infrared-platform-tokens that holds a Cloudflare token for domain's zone alone, when it is not the sign-in URL host's zone (infrared-docs-internal ADR 0063): cloudflare-domain-api-token, from platformTokens.cloudflareDomainApiToken. A Gateway edge then takes the certificate and DNS records of *.<domain> with it. A Secret's key: letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', neither . nor starting with ..; empty: cloudflare-api-token serves both names.

telemetry.description: spec.observability.telemetry (INFRARED_TELEMETRY_URL, INFRARED_TELEMETRY_PLATFORM): the telemetry plane an install without the metrics stack writes to, and its platform label (ADR 0044).

cloud.description: The control plane's cloud: picks the default image registry and chart repository (ADR 0033); empty is gcp.

templateVersion.description: A tag of infrared-gitops-template, or a full 40-character commit SHA.

chartRepository.description: The OCI repository of this chart, host and path with no oci://, tag or trailing slash (INFRARED_CHART_REPO); empty for the cloud's.

registry.description: Registry prefix of every component image; empty for the cloud's default.

imageCredentials.description: The Secret named by imagePullSecrets[0], rendered when username and password are set.

registry.description: Registry host the credential is for.

password.description: Pass it with --set-file; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

registryToken.description: The registry token: a Google service account's access token for a private Artifact Registry (Workload Identity, no key), or ECR's token as an IAM role, written to the Secret registry-token every 30 minutes.

gcpServiceAccount.description: The Google service account, <name>@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com; empty for none.

region.description: The ECR region; empty for no ECR token.

roleArn.description: An IAM role for IRSA on EKS; empty for the node's role.

hostNetwork.description: Run the Job on the host's network, for nodes whose instance metadata answers one hop.

registry.description: The registry host the token is for; empty for image.registry's host.

image.description: The Job's image, with curl, jq, kubectl and the AWS CLI, by digest.

license.description: The install's licence: rendered into Secret infrared-license from key, or read from existingSecret.

existingSecret.description: An existing Secret with key license; handed to the API and operator as INFRARED_LICENSE_SECRET.

platformTokens.description: Secret infrared-platform-tokens, rendered when a token is set, or with codeIndex.enabled the code index's record.

cloudflareApiToken.description: Key cloudflare-api-token. Pass it with --set-file; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

cloudflareDomainApiToken.description: Key cloudflare-domain-api-token: a Cloudflare token for installation.previews.domain's zone alone, which installation.previews.domainTokenKey names (infrared-docs-internal ADR 0063). Pass it with --set-file; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

backupAccessKeyId.description: Key backup-access-key-id, with backupSecretAccessKey; refused with Google Cloud Storage, which takes no key. Pass it with --set-file; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

backupSecretAccessKey.description: Key backup-secret-access-key, with backupAccessKeyId. Pass it with --set-file; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

codeIndexGithubAppId.description: Key code-index-github-app-id: the code index's GitHub App's ID, a number, with codeIndexGithubAppInstallationId and codeIndexGithubAppPrivateKey, and only with codeIndex.enabled. Pass it with --set-file or --set-string; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

codeIndexGithubAppInstallationId.description: Key code-index-github-app-installation-id: the ID of that App's installation, a number, with the other two. Pass it with --set-file or --set-string; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

codeIndexGithubAppPrivateKey.description: Key code-index-github-app-private-key: that App's private key, PEM, with the other two. Pass it with --set-file; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

googleClientId.description: Key google-client-id: Sign in with Google's OAuth client ID, ending in .apps.googleusercontent.com, with googleClientSecret. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

googleClientSecret.description: Key google-client-secret: that client's secret, with googleClientId. Pass it with --set-file; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

existingSecret.description: infrared-platform-tokens when it already exists; the chart then renders none.
Name of an existing Secret; when set the chart renders none.
Name of an existing Secret; when set the chart renders none.

moveIssueToHydratedRepo.description: Move a Change to the Product repo its hydration names (INFRARED_MOVE_ISSUE_TO_HYDRATED_REPO).

metricsPort.description: The manager's metrics endpoint, the Service port named metrics (ADR 0044).

metricsSecure.description: Serve the manager's metrics over HTTPS with Kubernetes authentication instead of plain HTTP in the cluster (ADR 0044).

strategy.description: How a new API rolls out: the Deployment's strategy. The default surges (the new pod beside the old one, the old stops once the new is ready); Recreate where no node has room for a second API.

flags.description: Flags (ADR 0058): install-class behaviour declared in infrared-api, rendered into the ConfigMap infrared-flags, which the API reads every 15 seconds with no rollout. Keys are camelCase with no dots; values are a string, a bool or an int, never a map or a list.

clientAddressHeader.description: INFRARED_CLIENT_ADDRESS_HEADER: the header that carries a caller's address, which the password sign-in's limits count failures by, such as CF-Connecting-IP behind Cloudflare; empty means the first X-Forwarded-For address.

directory.description: Workspace groups as roles (ADR 0042): how the API reads the groups teams name.

serviceAccount.description: INFRARED_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: the Google service account the API impersonates to read Workspace groups, <name>@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com, holding Groups Reader; empty turns the directory off.

api.description: INFRARED_DIRECTORY_API: admin, the Admin SDK Directory API, which tells a suspended person, or cloud-identity, the Cloud Identity API; empty is the API's default, admin.

interval.description: INFRARED_DIRECTORY_INTERVAL: how often the groups are read, a Go duration such as 2m; empty is the API's default, 2m.

maxAge.description: INFRARED_DIRECTORY_MAX_AGE: how long a group's last good read gives roles, a Go duration such as 10m; empty is the API's default, 10m.

metricsPort.description: INFRARED_METRICS_ADDR: the API's own metrics, the Service port named metrics (ADR 0044).

extensions.description: Extensions the UI shows in its rail and proxies at /ext/<id>/<path>/; empty leaves the slot off.

id.description: Names the routes /x/<id>/ and /ext/<id>/; '-' becomes '_' in nginx names.

upstream.description: host:port of the extension's Service; the host is a fully qualified name (it contains a dot), e.g. back-office.back-office.svc.cluster.local:8080.

paths.description: First path segments proxied from /ext/<id>/<path>/ to <upstream>/<path>/; default [v1, ui].

entry.description: Absolute path of the remote module under /ext/<id>/ui/; empty means /ext/<id>/ui/entry.js.

existingSecret.description: Secret whose value the UI sends to extension upstreams as X-Infrared-Proxy-Secret; required when extensions is not empty.

registry.description: Registry prefix product images are built into; empty disables the builds component.

placement.description: Where Product builds run: written into each kpack Image's spec.build.

address.description: Host and port builds and nodes reach the registry at, no scheme (INFRARED_REGISTRY); empty means none.

retention.description: Zot's garbage collection and retention (INFRARED_REGISTRY_RETENTION, as JSON); each empty field keeps the template's default.

untaggedAfter.description: An untagged image goes this long after it was untagged, e.g. 48h; empty: 24h.

keepTags.description: Regular expressions; a tag matching one is kept. Empty: ["^v[0-9]"].

keepNewest.description: Each repository's newest tags kept besides; 0: 10.

gcInterval.description: How often garbage is collected; empty: 1h.

gcDelay.description: How long after its last use a blob may be collected; empty: 1h.

enabled.description: Install the platform's stores through the gitops template (INFRARED_STORES).

singleNode.description: With enabled, the object store runs on the cluster's one node, every file written once (INFRARED_STORES_SINGLE_NODE).

backup.description: The install's backups, which seed the Installation's spec.backup once, while it is empty: the bucket (INFRARED_BACKUP, as JSON), all three of bucket, endpoint and region or none, and a prefix only with them; the rest (INFRARED_COPIES, as JSON).

bucket.description: Bucket name: 3 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens.

endpoint.description: The bucket's S3 endpoint: https:// and a host, no path; https://storage.googleapis.com for Google Cloud Storage, reached keyless by the Jobs' ServiceAccounts.

region.description: The region S3 requests are signed for, e.g. us-east-1; for Google Cloud Storage the bucket's location, e.g. us-central1.

prefix.description: The path everything is kept under in the bucket: 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens; empty: managementCluster.name.

schedule.description: A backup, by the operator's CronJob infrared-backup: five cron fields, UTC; empty keeps 5 * * * *.
The buckets' mirror to the backup bucket: five cron fields, UTC; empty keeps 17 * * * *.

retention.description: How long each backup, and what the mirror replaced or deleted, is kept: whole days such as 7d; empty keeps 7d.

recipients.description: age X25519 recipients (age1...), public keys only, each backup is encrypted to. Empty makes no backup.

archive.description: Barman's WAL archive of the platform's Postgres in the backup bucket, besides the dump in each backup; off by default.

restore.description: Restore at install from one of the backup bucket's backups (INFRARED_RESTORE).

enabled.description: Restore this install; needs stores.enabled and a backup bucket, and with Gitea gitea.replicaCount 0.

from.description: The newest complete backup at or before this time is restored, RFC 3339 in UTC; empty, with no point: the newest.

point.description: Exactly this backup is restored, by its stamp, such as 20261006T010500Z; not with from.

postgresImage.description: The restore Job's Postgres sidecar, which restores each consumer database's dump: the image the gitops template's Postgres Cluster runs, as name:tag@sha256:digest.

disabled.description: The gitops template's components the install leaves out, by name (INFRARED_DISABLED_COMPONENTS, as JSON).

testActors.description: Agent Substrate's test actors, counter-v1 and sandbox-v1. False, with stores.enabled and registry.address, names substrate-test-actors among the components left out (INFRARED_DISABLED_COMPONENTS).

tenancy.description: How the install fences one org from another and from the platform (infrared-docs-internal ADR 0066). Every switch is off by default.

enabled.description: The network fence (ADR 0066 D1): the operator fences every org's namespaces (INFRARED_NETWORK_POLICIES), the gitops template every platform namespace, and this chart its own. Needs a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicy.

The registry by identity (ADR 0066 D3; INFRARED_REGISTRY_PULLS): the install's registry reads for no one without a login, and each zone pulls as its org's own registry user (the Secret zot-pull on its default ServiceAccount). Needs registry.address.
The stores' own security (ADR 0066 D3; INFRARED_STORES_SECURITY): SeaweedFS under mutual TLS from cert-manager and signed tokens, the master's HTTP API off. Needs stores.enabled.

Infrared's code index, which the gitops template runs in the namespace code-index. On, its image is handed to the operator among Infrared's own (INFRARED_IMAGES, code-index); it needs image.registry other than the default.

knowledge.description: The code index's record, which the install writes into infrared-platform-tokens with codeIndex.enabled (keys code-index-knowledge-url and code-index-knowledge-ref) and the gitops template copies to code-index/code-index-settings.

url.description: The knowledge repository's URL, https:// or http://. Required with codeIndex.enabled wherever the chart renders infrared-platform-tokens.

ref.description: The branch, tag or commit to read it at; empty means main. No leading -, and none of whitespace, : ^ ~ ? * [ or \, which the code index refuses.

tag.description: The tag of <image.registry>/infrared-codeindex, e.g. one-install-<short sha>.

digest.description: Its digest, sha256:...; empty pins by the tag alone.

permissions.description: INFRARED_RUNNER_PERMISSIONS: strict makes each step's AgentRole's allowed tools, with the runner's workspace tools, the agent's whole surface (ADR 0066 D7). Empty: no permission checks, as before.

enabled.description: Fence runner pods with a NetworkPolicy.

extraEgressCIDRs.description: Private CIDRs runners may reach over HTTP(S).

egressByName.description: Runners' internet egress by name through GKE FQDN network policies (ADR 0066 D7; INFRARED_RUNNER_EGRESS). Needs networkPolicy.enabled.

enabled.description: Fence runners' internet egress to the model API, these hosts, each step's forge, AgentRole hosts and Slack.

hosts.description: Hosts every step may reach besides the model API: names, or a wildcard over one level; never an address or a name only the cluster resolves.

golangciLintImage.description: INFRARED_GOLANGCI_LINT_IMAGE: the image an init container copies golangci-lint (/usr/bin/golangci-lint) from into every agent step's /tools/bin.

placement.description: Where agent steps' runner pods run, and the agent's container's resources.

metricsWriteURL.description: INFRARED_METRICS_WRITE_URL: where remote-write bodies at POST /api/v1/telemetry/write are forwarded; empty means metricsURL plus /api/v1/write (ADR 0044).

giteaAdmin.description: Secret infrared-gitea-admin, Gitea's site admin, rendered once when gitea.enabled.

existingSecret.description: infrared-gitea-admin when it already exists; the chart then renders none.

gitea.description: Gitea: the gitea chart's own values, preset for one pod. gitea.enabled turns it on.

enabled.description: Run Gitea, and hand its address (INFRARED_GITEA_URL) and admin Secret (INFRARED_GITEA_ADMIN_SECRET) on.

browserURL.description: INFRARED_GITEA_BROWSER_URL (api): the address browsers open this Gitea at, such as https://git.example.com; Gitea's ROOT_URL follows it, with a trailing slash (ADR 0053). Set, Infrared can register its own Gitea connector (ADR 0042), and with oidc.enabled and installation.previews.signInURL Gitea signs people in through Infrared. Needs gitea.enabled.

fullnameOverride.description: Fixed: the Service the operator and the API reach is gitea-http.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of Gitea's volume; empty uses the cluster's default.

existingSecret.description: Fixed: Gitea reads its admin from the Secret giteaAdmin describes.

replicaCount.description: One pod, or none: 0 while a restore fills Gitea's volume.

namespace.description: The namespace for the org registries' credentials.
The namespace for workload Clusters' OpenTofu state.

tag.description: Tag; empty means the chart appVersion.
